en.headline: Observatory issues yellow fire danger warning on Chung Yeung morning
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory raised the yellow signal at 8:15am as fire risk remains high amid dry conditions and expected hill visits.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a yellow fire danger warning at 8:15am on Sunday, warning that the risk of fire is high.

The Observatory said people should take extra precautions to prevent fires and that hikers should remain vigilant. The warning comes on Chung Yeung Festival, when many residents visit hills and cemeteries for ancestral rites.

A fresh to strong easterly airstream is affecting the coast of Guangdong, bringing mainly cloudy weather with sunny periods and dry conditions during the day. The maximum temperature is expected around 31 degrees in urban areas.

zh.headline: 天文台重陽節早上發出黃色火災危險警告
zh.dek: 天文台於上午8時15分發出黃色火災危險警告，表示火災危險性頗高，市民及登山人士應提高警覺。
body: 香港天文台於星期日上午8時15分發出黃色火災危險警告，表示本港火災危險性頗高。
天文台呼籲市民採取適當措施防止火警發生，登山人士亦應特別小心。警告於重陽節發出，當日不少市民會登山或前往墳場拜祭先人。
一股清勁至強風程度的偏東氣流正影響廣東沿岸，今日大致多雲，日間部分時間有陽光及乾燥，市區最高氣溫約31度。
